tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Full-text search across Ricky Moorhouse's blog posts, microblog notes, talks and projects. Covers API architecture, IBM API Connect, SRE, observability and AI agents, plus travel, photography and walking. Returns matching posts with their URL, date, tags and description; use get_post to read one in

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Fetch the full text of a page on rickymoorhouse.uk as Markdown, given its URL.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: List the most recent posts, newest first, optionally from one section.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, list_recent · Public sink: get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, list_recent · Public sink: get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
